Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

Are you accurate, flexible, and do you enjoy working in a clean production environment? For a modern food company in Zottegem, we are looking for packers.

Below is the list of tasks for this position:

• Correctly packaging fine food products according to the established standards. 
• Carrying out quality checks to ensure that every product meets our high standards. 
• Setting up and adjusting machines to guarantee a smooth production process. 
• Working together with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met and customers remain satisfied. 
• As a packer, you make sure our products are perfectly packaged before they are sent to our customers.

• You can speak Dutch or English.
• You can work either from 6h-14h, 14h-22h or 22h-6h. 
• You are at least 3 days a week available to work.
• You can choose which day and shift you wanna work.
• You have experience in a production environment.

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

In this role, you will ensure the precise finishing of aluminium profiles and frames. You will alternate between production runs and bespoke work, with quality always being the top priority. You'll receive a salary starting at €17.50 per hour, depending on your experience, supplemented by meal vouchers.

Do you enjoy working precisely with metal and do you derive satisfaction from a perfectly finished end product? Then be sure to read on!

What does your day look like as a grinder?

 
• 
You will grind and deburr aluminium profiles in accordance with the technical drawings

 
• 
You carry out visual quality checks on your own grinding work

 
• 
You alternate between series production and custom-made pieces

 
• 
You process production orders via an ERP system

 
• 
You follow quality through control sheets

 
• 
You carry out first-line maintenance, e.g. replacing sanding brushes, maintaining work equipment, etc.

Do you already have experience as a metalworker or do you already have knowledge of an ERP system ? This is definitely a plus!

 
• 
You're good at reading technical drawings and enjoy working with precision

 
• 
You're good working with measuring tools

 
• 
You're quality-oriented and value order and tidiness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
A job on the permanent night shift is just what you're looking for, and do you already have experience in

Our client is a leading player in the events industry, specialising in the design and manufacture of exhibition stand systems. The company is renowned for its innovative approach and high-quality products, which are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions and events.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

As a Production Technician, you will provide technical support within an automated production environment, with a 50/50 split between mechanical and electrical work. You will troubleshoot, analyse and resolve technical faults on a varied range of machinery, including CNC machines, robots, milling and sawing machines, while also carrying out preventive maintenance and implementing improvements together with the Technical Manager. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, as well as thorough training and ongoing support in a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

For a leading company in the events industry, Let's Work is looking for a CNC Milling Machine Operator to work in a 2-shift system. You will join a technically challenging role with plenty of variety, where precision and quality are key.

What will your responsibilities be as a CNC Milling Machine Operator?

 
• 
Mill aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and specifications

 
• 
Alternate between series production and custom work, providing plenty of variety in your job

 
• 
For new parts, create milling programs and correctly set up the machine

 
• 
Load and unload the milling machine and monitor the production process

 
• 
Check the quality of your work using measuring tools such as a vernier caliper and tape measure

 
• 
Monitor quality using inspection sheets and process production orders in the ERP system

 
• 
Carry out first-line maintenance of the machine

 
• 
You have experience as a CNC milling machine operator 

 
• 
You can easily read technical drawings and accurately take measurements using measuring instruments

 
• 
Knowledge of ERP systems is a strong advantage

 
• 
You work accurately and with a strong focus on quality, and you pay attention to order and cleanliness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system fits perfectly with your work routine

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.

• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.

• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.

• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.

• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.

• Fluent in English
